transcript:
MARTIN: Have a look in there.

DAVID: Really?!

MARTIN: It's what you're there for! 

DAVID (Playfully) FIIIIINNNNE!

[SFX:footsteps]

DAVID (CONT’D in presenter voice): So I'm standing in an empty damp hall, clearly a place used for the more difficult patients. It's lined with about four cells, each with small, round, windows. I can't imagine this place was ever hospitable. 

MARTIN: Can you open any of them? 

[SFX: We hear a door trying to be opened - it’s locked]

DAVID (CONT’D): Just the one. Seems when the doors close, they lock, but some junk kept this one from closing.
